test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A and B can do a piece of work in 10 days and 15 days, respectively. They worked together, but 5 days before the completion of the work, A left. In how many days was the work completed?
solution: Given: A and B can do a work in 10 and 15 days respectively. A work 5 less days Concept used: Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)
